name: Genetic Ancestry
description: Genetic ancestries were determined using five different methods as described in Carrot-Zhang et al (2020). These consensus calls were created based on the ancestral population that received the majority of assignments for each patient. The original data is here.

name: Putative copy-number alterations from GISTIC
description: Putative copy-number from GISTIC 2.0. Values: -2 = homozygous deletion; -1 = hemizygous deletion; 0 = neutral / no change; 1 = gain; 2 = high level amplification.

name: Log2 copy-number values
description: Log2 copy-number values for each gene (from Affymetrix SNP6).

name: Mutations
description: Mutation data from whole exome sequencing of 566 Lung Adenocarcinoma samples.
